name: ShotLab
subtitle: Basketball Training, Connected
promotionalText: Turn daily basketball work into visible progress with coach priorities, shot logging, team events, strength sessions, leaderboards, and season insight.
description:
ShotLab connects coaches and players around the daily work that builds better basketball teams.

FOR PLAYERS
• Open a personalized Daily Training Command Center with one clear next action.
• Log at-home shots and coach-assigned program drills.
• Track weekly makes, streaks, personal bests, and team ranking.
• Confirm event and strength-session attendance.
• Review progress across training, team commitments, and the season.

FOR COACHES
• Run a complete basketball development program from one dashboard.
• Invite players and manage the active roster.
• Set training priorities and organize drill plans.
• Create events and strength and conditioning sessions.
• Monitor attendance, activity, leaderboards, and player development.
• Archive seasons and compare results over time.

ShotLab is built for structured offseason development, in-season accountability, and long-term program growth. Some features require a coach-created team or invitation.

review.notes: ShotLab has separate Coach and Player experiences. Use the owner-provided Coach account to review Players, Events, Drills, Strength and Conditioning, Leaderboards, Activity, and Season Archive. Use the owner-provided Player account to review the Daily Training Command Center, At Home, Program, Events, Strength and Conditioning, Leaderboards, Profile, and in-app account deletion. Production demo access is disabled by default.
